vb_textbox.text: In general, pointy hats are better than round ones. Blue pointy hats are particularly good.  I found that it only went better to choose round over pointy a couple of times.  For most of the time, if given a choice between yellow round or red round, yellow round is better but it switches from time to time and more often than from pointy to round.  So stick with pointy hats unless you get a really bad result for a couple of goes in which case try a round over a pointy until it switches back, and go for yellow round over red round but those switch more often.
